claims.evidence: Witness report describes a white heavy-duty truck with a red concrete mixer drum and a concrete pumping/placing boom-like attachment, not a borehole drilling rig.
No evidence of operation/testing; witness only reports visible construction attachment and no engine/start or performance checks.
Witness report does not show the machine running, mixer rotating, or pumping/placing system operating.
No service records, receipts, or visible maintenance indicators were reported.
Witness notes hoses/piping and framework but does not confirm completeness of all components (e.g., valves, cylinders, electrical panels, spare parts).
No readable brand/model/serial numbers were reported.

risks.risk: Item mismatch / possible misrepresentation: seller claims borehole drilling machine, but witness sees a concrete mixer truck with pumping/placing attachment.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the machine’s nameplate/serial plate and the full unit showing whether it is a drilling rig or a mixer/pump truck (including any drilling mast/rig components if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a construction mixer/pump truck with unknown working condition (worst-case: non-verified operation and potential wrong listing).

risks.risk: Non-working or poor mechanical condition (engine, hydraulics, mixer rotation, pump/valves) despite claims.
risks.proof: Short video clip showing: engine start, mixer drum rotation, and pumping/placing operation with pressure/flow (or at least valve actuation) plus any visible leaks.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case as not proven working (assume major servicing/repairs may be needed).

risks.risk: Hydraulic/piping leaks or worn components (hoses, cylinders, fittings) that are not visible in still photos.
risks.proof: Close-up clips of all hose runs and hydraulic connections while operating (look for wetness, drips, or pressure spraying).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential leak/repair risk (worst-case: hydraulic overhaul needed).

risks.risk: Structural/attachment integrity issues (frame/boom rails/welds) not confirmed by the report.
risks.proof: High-resolution photos of welds and attachment joints from multiple angles, plus a clip showing the boom/rails movement if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible structural wear/damage (worst-case: reinforcement/repairs).

risks.risk: Unknown capacity/specs (mixer volume, pump output, hose length, boom reach) affecting market value.
risks.proof: Photo of capacity plate/spec sheet and any pump/mixer rating labels; also a measurement/label showing hose length and rated output.
risks.if_unproven: Price using the lowest plausible spec tier for similar units (worst-case unknown capacity).

risks.risk: Documentation/roadworthiness and ownership risk (papers, inspection status) not shown.
risks.proof: Photos/scans of ownership documents, inspection/roadworthiness status, and any VIN/engine/chassis number matching paperwork.
risks.if_unproven: Price as documentation not verified (worst-case: delays and additional compliance costs).

risks.risk: Tyre/brake/suspension condition unknown; could require immediate replacement.
risks.proof: Clear photos of tyre tread depth/sidewall condition, brake components (where visible), and suspension/underbody inspection; plus a short drive/stop clip.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming tyres/brakes may need replacement (worst-case immediate maintenance).

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the machine’s nameplate/serial plate (brand, model, serial/VIN) and any capacity/rating plates.
Provide a short video showing the unit starting, mixer drum rotating, and the pumping/placing system operating (including any pressure/flow indication if available).
Show close-ups of all hydraulic hoses, fittings, valves, and joints while operating to confirm no leaks.
Provide photos of the attachment welds/joints from multiple angles (front, side, rear) and any structural inspection points.
Send documentation: ownership papers, inspection/roadworthiness status, and matching chassis/engine numbers.
Show tyre/brake/suspension condition with clear close-ups and a short drive/stop clip.
response.reason: The witness report identifies a concrete mixer/pumping truck, which contradicts the seller’s claim of a borehole drilling machine, and there is no proof of operation, capacity, or documentation. Without key verification shots/videos, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
